title: Efficient modeling of chemotherapy regimens using mixed-integer linear programming
summary: In this article, we focus on determining a minimum-cost treatment program aimed at maintaining the size of a cancerous tumor at a level that allows the patient to live comfortably. At each predetermined point in a treatment horizon, the patient either receives drug treatment or does not. In the first case, the tumor shrinks and its size is multiplied by a constant factor lower than 1; in the second, it grows following an exponential or Gompertz growth law.
